title: An India-Ready SaaS Stack: Better Auth, PostgreSQL, Payments, CMS and Multi-Platform Apps
excerpt: A source-owned SaaS architecture for Indian founders, covering authentication, PostgreSQL, replaceable billing providers, CMS boundaries and shared web, desktop and mobile contracts.
seoTitle: India-Ready SaaS Stack: Auth, Postgres & Payments
seoDescription: Design an India-ready SaaS stack with Better Auth, PostgreSQL, adaptable payments, an operational CMS and shared web, desktop and mobile contracts.
author: Anoop Karnik
